create_HuggingfacePredictorConfig: create a HuggingfacePredictorConfig dataclass to configure model name, tokenizer, batch size, and repetition penalty for LLM inference
build_HuggingfacePredictor_from_config: build a HuggingfacePredictor from a HuggingfacePredictorConfig by loading a pretrained HuggingFace model and tokenizer with device placement
run_HuggingfacePredictor_call: run the HuggingfacePredictor on a list of text prompts to generate predictions with configurable temperature, top_p, and max generation length
review_HuggingfacePredictor_logprobs: review the HuggingfacePredictor call method to return logprobs for prompt tokens and generated tokens using transition scores
test_HuggingfacePredictor_batching: test the HuggingfacePredictor batching logic that sorts prompts by length and processes them in configurable generator batch sizes
